public.title: Symmetric Tree
public.description: Return whether a binary tree is a mirror image of itself about the root. Both shape and values must match in mirrored positions; an empty tree is symmetric. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: Pair the left child of one side with the right child of the other.
Missing nodes must also match across the mirror.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Recursively compare opposite child pairs and matching values. O(n) time and O(h) call space.
